# HighLevel API v3: full reference

> Every endpoint of HighLevel API version v3 (812 endpoints in 46 services). Compact reference generated from the OpenAPI specs: every endpoint lists what is needed to call it.

- Base URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com
- Send the header `Version: v3` on every request.
- Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless the endpoint says "Auth: none".
- Index of this version: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/llms/v3/llms.txt

DELETE /ad-publishing/facebook/integration
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/integration
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-delete-integration | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-delete-integration.md

Remove the Facebook ad integration from a location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) LocationIdBodyDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (Acknowledgement that the integration was removed) application/json:
- success* boolean - True when the operation succeeded

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Delete page connection
DELETE /ad-publishing/facebook/page
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/page
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-delete-page | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-delete-page.md

DEPRECATED. Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Remove a Facebook page connection from a location. Deprecated: use DELETE /ad-publishing/facebook/pages/{pageId} with header version: v4.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- pageId* string (e.g. "123456789") - Facebook page ID

Response 200 (Acknowledgement that the page was disconnected) application/json:
- success* boolean - True when the operation succeeded

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Duplicate ad

Duplicate an existing Facebook ad

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- adId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013") - Ad identifier
